description: This file contains an implementation of the MD5 Message-Digest Algorithm compatible with OpenSSL, including core functions, macros, and context management functions.

methods.name: MD5_Init
methods.description: Initializes the MD5 context with standard starting values.

methods.name: MD5_Update
methods.description: Processes input data and updates the MD5 hash context.

methods.name: MD5_Final
methods.description: Completes the MD5 hash computation and outputs the digest.
